summary.zh-CN: 首页和专辑列表保留专辑整体截止提醒，移除曲目逾期数量提示，并同步调整关注筛选与排序。
summary.en: The dashboard and album list retain overall album deadline reminders, remove overdue track counts, and align attention filtering and sorting.

description.zh-CN: 保留“今日截止”“逾期 N 天”“还剩 N 天”，移除“X 首逾期”。已完成和已归档专辑继续隐藏截止提醒。
description.en: Keep due-today, days-overdue and days-left reminders while removing overdue track counts. Completed and archived albums continue to hide deadline reminders.

description.zh-CN: 首页关注专辑由整体截止状态和未解决问题决定，按问题数排序；专辑列表关注排序综合整体截止状态和未解决问题。阶段曲目逾期数量的关注权重已移除，阶段日期设置和待办保持原有行为。
description.en: Dashboard attention includes albums based on overall deadlines and open issues, ordered by issue count. Album-list attention sorting combines overall deadlines and open issues. Overdue track counts no longer add attention weight; phase-deadline settings and tasks retain their existing behavior.
